_comment: LBNL FDD dual-duct AHU (DDAHU) point name -> CAMBER Role mapping, at the air-handler level. A fourth BAS naming convention: a hot-deck/cold-deck dual-duct AHU with both coils and an OA economizer. The outdoor-air-fraction detector applies at the mixing box (OA/MA/RA temps + OA damper); the cold-deck discharge maps to supply_air_temp. Dataset: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets (CC-BY). Valves and dampers map to the controller DEMAND columns (*_DM), not the measured positions: CAMBER's rules read these roles as commands (a leak is cooling while the valve is *commanded* closed; economizer drift is OA fraction *at matched damper command*), and a stuck or leaking device's position is precisely what hides the fault. Until 0.82.0 these mapped the positions.
